predecessors.name: Serbia and Montenegro (Federal Republic of Yugoslavia)
predecessors.text: the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro less Montenegro, which declared independence on 3 June 2006; Serbia's parliament 'did the same' on 5 June 2006, 'effectively dissolving the union'

ledger.x: 5 June 2006: Serbia declares independence two days after Montenegro, and the State Union ends.
ledger.cpn: Serbia and Montenegro (Federal Republic of Yugoslavia)

certainty.note: Serbia's outer line is an international frontier on every side except Kosovo (the pages opened give no demarcation dates).
